en.headline: CFS urges public not to consume two Olitalia olive oil products
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety said the Italian-brand Pomace Olive Oil in 1-litre and 5-litre bottles may contain mineral oil aromatic hydrocarbons after a Belgian recall notice.
body: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department advised the public on Tuesday not to consume two products under the brand Olitalia: Pomace Olive Oil in 1-litre and 5-litre bottles.

The centre learned through its food-incident surveillance system that the Belgian Federal Agency for the Safety of the Food Chain had issued a notice detecting mineral oil aromatic hydrocarbons in the products above local standards and was recalling all batches.

A local distributor, Yi Sang Trading Company Limited, had supplied the products. As a precautionary measure the distributor has stopped sale, removed the items from shelves and begun a recall. Consumers may call the distributor’s hotline during office hours for return arrangements. The centre has contacted Belgian authorities and will continue to follow up.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食用兩款Olitalia橄欖油 或含礦物油
zh.dek: 食安中心指意大利品牌Olitalia的1公升及5公升瓶裝Pomace Olive Oil可能含芳香族碳氫化合物礦物油，分銷商已停售下架並回收。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心周二呼籲市民不要食用品牌「Olitalia」兩款分別1公升及5公升瓶裝「Pomace Olive Oil」橄欖油，指相關產品可能含有礦物油（芳香族碳氫化合物）。
中心透過食物事故監察系統得悉比利時聯邦食物鏈安全署發出通告，指相關產品被檢出礦物油含量超出當地標準，當地正進行回收。
初步調查顯示本地分銷商義生洋行有限公司曾供應相關產品。作為預防措施，分銷商已停售、下架及展開回收。市民可於辦公時間致電熱線查詢回收事宜。中心已聯絡比利時當局，並會繼續跟進。
